newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips sees q4 charge of DFl one billion.
newsitem.headline: Philips sees q4 charge of DFl one billion.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Thursday it anticipated booking a pre-tax charge of one billion guilders in the fourth quarter 1996.
It said that the improvement in its business anticipated in the second half compared to the same period of 1995 was "most unlikely to materialise".

"Analysis of our business ... demonstrates the need to accelerate planned actions for recovery. Consequently we anticipate that we will recognise a charge in the fourth quarter of 1996 of approximately one billion guilders before tax," Philips said in a statement.
Philips reported third quarter net from normal operations of 123 million guilders in 1996 compared to 539 million guilders in the same period of 1995.
There were no extraordinary charges or gains in the third quarter. -- Amsterdam newsroom, +31 20 504 5000
